newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's launches $0.55 campaign at breakfast.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's launches $0.55 campaign at breakfast.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Wednesday it would launch its $0.55 sandwich promotion, which had been expected to start later this month with hamburgers, with its breakfast menu on Friday.
McDonald's said it will offer its four breakfast sandwiches at $0.55 each when customers also purchase hash brown potatoes and a drink.
The company had been expected to begin the promotion -- known as Campaign 55 -- on April 25, starting with its hamburgers.

To support the promotion, McDonald's said it will introduce new national advertising on Friday. New commercials, created by Leo Brunett Co of Chicago, will feature local McDonald's franchisees, managers and restaurant crews from coast to coast.
McDonald's, the top fast-food chain, has more than 21,000 restaurants in 101 countries.
